  APPLICATION OF SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER
  COMPANY FOR AUTHORITY TO AMEND TARIFFS FOR
RETAIL ELECTRIC SERVICE TO INCLUDE NEW STANDARD
FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE – LARGE LOAD




                              SOAH ORDER NO. 8
                               REQUIRING FILING

        For ease of the administration of the hearing scheduled for Wednesday,
August 12, 2026, Southwestern Electric Power Company SHALL file an agreed
list of presentation of witnesses by close of business August 11, 2026. This list will
include the witnesses from all parties, designate whether it is direct or rebuttal
testimony, in the order to be presented at trial. If there are any witnesses that have
been waived ahead of the hearing, that information shall be noted in the filing.


Signed August 9, 2026
                                       _____________________________
                                       Rachelle Nicolette Robles,
                                       Administrative Law Judge
